data: Which solid line is constantly higher than other solid lines?

The caption states that the dashed lines represent the result obtained on full datasets. The solid lines represent the learning curves for different areas. The question asks which solid line is constantly higher than others. From the analysis of the graph, the red line (Chemistry) appears to be consistently above all other solid lines throughout the training size range. Therefore, the red line is the one that is constantly higher than the others.
